  {"id": "c6", "text": "When it detects rising water risks it sends radio signals that can travel more than a half-mile through city streets and up to five miles in open areas to a local central hub where emergency teams can monitor conditions.", "quote": "These low-power signals can travel more than a half-mile through city streets and up to five miles in open areas without needing cell towers or power lines.
